name: Vienna Life Assistant
description: Personal life management with FastMCP — calendar, todos, expenses, health (doctor visits, medications, vitals), travel (trips, packing, documents), contacts (birthdays), household (subscriptions, home tasks, pet care), personal journal (mood, streak, on-this-day), and a news site fed by the fleet aiwatcher engine. Portmanteau tools, 6 prompts, 6 skills, local LLM auto-discovery, SQLite persistence.

tools.name: vienna_life
tools.description: Daily life ops: calendar, todos, expenses, shopping list, life brief, fleet overview, health, help

tools.name: vienna_health
tools.description: Doctor visits, medications (active + refill), vitals, medical conditions

tools.name: vienna_travel
tools.description: Trips with countdown, packing checklists, travel documents with expiry alerts

tools.name: vienna_contacts
tools.description: People, relationships, upcoming birthdays with age

tools.name: vienna_household
tools.description: Subscriptions with monthly total, home maintenance tasks, pet care events

tools.name: vienna_log
tools.description: Personal journal: daily entries with mood and tags, streak, on-this-day recall, search

tools.name: vienna_news
tools.description: Personal news site fed by aiwatcher: top stories, trends, search, morning digest

tools.name: vienna_life_agentic
tools.description: Multi-step life planning via MCP sampling
